description: Defines the DarkModeSetting enum used for managing dark mode preferences in an Android application, with methods to convert between enum instances, integer mode IDs, and string representation in SharedPreferences.

classes.name: DarkModeSetting
classes.description: Enumerates possible dark mode settings for the application, including methods to retrieve mode IDs and convert from mode IDs.

methods.name: getModeId
methods.description: Returns the integer ModeID associated with the enum value.

methods.name: fromModeID
methods.description: Returns the DarkModeSetting instance corresponding to a given ModeID, or throws NoSuchElementException if not found.
